title: Write plans, designs and approvals
responsibility: Adapts desktop planning requests into stored plans, design versions, image threads and approvals.

inputs.name: planningWrites.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to create a plan.

inputs.name: planningWrites.draft
inputs.description: The category, title, goal and optional proposed contract. The title must yield a nonempty lowercase letters-and-digits slug, limited to 64 characters.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to find or create a unit’s plan.

inputs.name: ensurePlan.unit
inputs.description: The existing unit definition whose identity, kind, title, responsibility and contract seed a plan when none exists. shared-function maps to function.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The repository and planning API used to add a design.

inputs.name: addPlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The design proposal, generator, base revision, expected latest version, optional image or separate options, notes and optional revised-image binding. Missing expectedLatest defaults to the current plan’s latest version.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to open a thread.

inputs.name: openPlanThread.draft
inputs.description: The entity and optional image anchor, including version, hash, state, viewport, region and option. An anchored image must belong to that entity/version and have the supplied state and viewport.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.context
inputs.description: The planning context used to approve a design.

inputs.name: approvePlanDesign.draft
inputs.description: The entity, design version, selected image hashes, contract hash and optional design option. Images must match the requested version or selected option.

outputs.name: reviewer
outputs.description: The local author identity: a person named Local reviewer.

outputs.name: planningWrites
outputs.description: A promise for the created plan record. New contracts use default state and desktop viewport for visual categories, diagram for others; missing proposed input/output/error lists become empty.

outputs.name: ensurePlan
outputs.description: A promise for the existing plan, or a new plan seeded from the unit. New plans preserve input/output fields but take only error names.

outputs.name: addPlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the added design version. Images are packaged as one image per option or a single image; the stored revised image is used to determine its option when found.

outputs.name: openPlanThread
outputs.description: A promise for the newly opened thread converted to its desktop summary.

outputs.name: approvePlanDesign
outputs.description: A promise for the saved approval summary, binding the selected images, contract hash and any design notes hash.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects titles that produce no slug, invalid image anchors or state/viewport mismatches, unknown design versions, mismatched approval images and failures from the planning API or follow-up reads.
